findings.heading: Creating an epicontacts object
findings.proposition: In a linelist, rows correspond to unique cases; the Portuguese says columns correspond to unique cases ("colunas sao variaveis e colunas correspondem a casos unicos").
findings.reader_consequence: A Portuguese reader is told a linelist has columns that are variables and columns that are cases, which is self-contradictory and hides the row-per-case structure the whole epicontacts object depends on.

findings.heading: Visualising edge attributes
findings.proposition: The Portuguese file carries the untranslated English sentence about edge_color/edge_width/edge_linetype as a separate line immediately before its Portuguese translation, so the paragraph is stated twice.
findings.reader_consequence: The reader meets the same instruction twice, once in a language the page is not written in, and may believe the two lines describe two different steps.

findings.heading: Identifying clusters
findings.proposition: The Portuguese file carries the untranslated English sentence "Let us look at the largest clusters..." as a separate line immediately before its Portuguese translation, so the paragraph is stated twice.
findings.reader_consequence: The reader meets the same instruction twice, once in English, and may read the two lines as two separate operations on the epicontacts object.

findings.heading: Saving plots and figures
findings.proposition: The English says visSave saves a plot; the Portuguese says it saves "um mapa" (a map).
findings.reader_consequence: A reader looking for how to save the transmission-network figure may not connect this section to it, because the chapter produces no map.

findings.heading: Overview
findings.proposition: Clicking a node highlights downstream cases; the Portuguese says it highlights "casos subjacentes" (underlying cases), which reverses or removes the direction of transmission.
findings.reader_consequence: The reader loses the fact that the highlight follows transmission forward from the clicked case, and may read the highlighted set as the sources of the case instead.
